verdict.rationale: Fin has 'CX Score', 'Custom AI Scorecards', 'AI Topics/Trends', and preview/test tooling that suggest some QA-adjacent scoring and monitoring capability, plus conversation-level error/status visibility for debugging. But there is no evidence of a structured sampling/scoring workflow, flagged-failure review queue, or a documented loop that feeds review outcomes back into agent behavior/training. missing for 10: documented sample-based QA scoring methodology, a review/flagging workflow for failed conversations, evidence of a closed feedback loop that updates the agent from QA findings, and independent corroboration of these QA features in practice.
